subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
question: If T(n)=2T(n/2)+n, what is the asymptotic complexity?
solution: The recurrence is T(n)=2T(n/2)+n.
Here a=2, b=2, so n^(log_b a)=n.
f(n)=n matches the critical term.
By Master Theorem Case 2, T(n)=Theta(n log n).
concept: Master Theorem compares the recursive work n^(log_b a) with the non-recursive work f(n).
trick: When f(n) matches n^(log_b a), multiply the base term by log n.

subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
question: Which traversal finds shortest paths from a source in an unweighted graph?
solution: In an unweighted graph every edge has equal cost.
BFS explores vertices level by level.
The first time a vertex is reached, the path uses the minimum number of edges.
concept: BFS uses a queue and discovers vertices in increasing distance from the source.
trick: Unweighted shortest path = BFS; weighted non-negative shortest path = Dijkstra.

subject: DBMS
question: Which normal form primarily removes transitive dependency of non-key attributes on a key?
solution: 1NF removes repeating groups and requires atomic values.
2NF removes partial dependency on a composite candidate key.
3NF removes transitive dependency of non-prime attributes on candidate keys.
Therefore the answer is 3NF.
concept: Normalization reduces redundancy and update anomalies by controlling functional dependencies.

subject: Operating Systems
question: Which scheduling algorithm can cause starvation of low-priority processes?
solution: In priority scheduling, a low-priority process may wait while higher-priority jobs continue arriving.
This can lead to indefinite waiting, called starvation.
Aging is a common technique to reduce starvation.
concept: Starvation means a process waits indefinitely because system policy repeatedly favors others.
trick: Starvation in priority scheduling? Think aging as the remedy.

subject: Computer Networks
question: TCP provides reliable delivery mainly using which mechanism?
solution: TCP numbers bytes/segments and expects acknowledgements.
Lost data can be retransmitted after timeout or duplicate ACK based mechanisms.
This provides reliable ordered delivery over an unreliable IP layer.
concept: TCP is connection-oriented and provides reliability, ordering, flow control and congestion control.
trick: TCP reliability = sequence numbers + ACK + retransmission.

subject: Theory of Computation
question: Which machine recognizes exactly the regular languages?
solution: A DFA has a finite set of states and no auxiliary stack.
The class of languages accepted by DFAs is exactly the class of regular languages.
NFAs recognize the same class as DFAs.
concept: Regular languages are recognized by finite automata such as DFA and NFA.
trick: Regular -> finite automaton; context-free -> PDA; recursively enumerable -> TM.

subject: Compiler Design
question: Which parser is a top-down parser?
solution: Top-down parsing starts from the start symbol and derives the input.
LL parsers construct a leftmost derivation.
LR-family parsers are bottom-up parsers.
concept: LL means Left-to-right scan and Leftmost derivation; LR means Left-to-right scan and Rightmost derivation in reverse.

subject: Computer Organization
question: Which cache mapping allows a memory block to be placed in any cache line?
solution: Direct mapping restricts a block to one line.
Set associative mapping restricts it to a set.
Fully associative mapping permits placement in any cache line.
concept: Cache mapping controls where a memory block can reside in cache.
trick: Any line = fully associative; one line = direct; one set = set associative.

subject: AIML
question: What is the main purpose of a validation set?
solution: Training data fits model parameters.
Validation data helps select hyperparameters and model variants.
The test set should remain unseen until final evaluation.
concept: Separating train, validation and test data helps estimate generalization honestly.
trick: Train = learn; validation = choose; test = final check.
